notes.text: Published coordinates are the OSM suburb node for the Manora island settlement itself; the beach is a ~2.5 km shoreline way (516413057) and 'Manora Point' returned no result in Nominatim, so no separate point is claimed for it. Boat access: the only jetty-like feature found in OSM is the 'PNS Qasim New Jetty' slipway on the island's east side; Karachi Port Trust's site (kpt.gov.pk) mentions Manora only in its history pages and no official page states a boat/ferry fare from Boat Basin or Hawke's Bay, so ticketPrices is null and no crossing price is published. The Commons photo shows Manora beach and is categorised 'Manora Beach' (its description also notes the island is connected to the mainland by a long causeway).

No official page stating entry conditions or fees for Manora beach could be found. The Commissioner Karachi Division swimming-ban notification No. CK/Home Br./(Swimming)/2026-22 (01.07.2026-23.08.2026, Section 144 Cr.P.C.) applies to beaches within Karachi Division; the notification is copied to the Cantonment Executive Officer, Cantonment Board Clifton, Manora & Korangi Creek, indicating a cantonment authority administers the Manora area.

The necropolis is inscribed on Pakistan's UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List (Ref. 1287, submitted 14/12/1993) and is conserved/managed by the Sindh Culture, Tourism & Antiquities Department (Government of Sindh), which posts guided tourist visits via its official Facebook page (facebook.com/AntiquitieSindh) - a login-walled page that could not be fetched here. notes.text: Nominatim has no 'State Bank Museum' feature (empty results for three queries); Overpass also has no museum node. Coordinates therefore use the OSM building way named 'State Bank of Pakistan' (building=commercial, 'Built in 1932') at the SBP headquarters on I.I Chundrigar Road, which the official museum pages identify as the museum's location ('State Bank of the Pakistan headquarters').
